summary: Tested live admin and employee authentication, protected APIs, dashboard data, CSV import, desktop navigation, transaction search, upload form, and mobile sidebar.
action_items: Align seed_data employee email with the required rohan@siteexpense.local credential for clean installations (server.py currently creates rohan@siteexpense.com).
Add API error states to Dashboard, Transactions, Upload, and Sites views so failed requests do not remain on an indefinite loading/empty state.
critical_code_review_comments: Employee seed credential is inconsistent with the documented/test credential; current environment passes because the user appears to have been seeded previously.
Upload screen requests /api/users, which is admin-only; employee users will receive 403 and see no employee options, despite the backend allowing employees to upload their own statement.
Frontend uses a global location reference instead of router location for the breadcrumb; it works in browsers but is less robust/testable.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_upload.csv transaction was created through the live upload API; it is prefixed TEST_ for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live public URL used from frontend/.env. Admin and employee login, cookie auth, dashboard, sites/categories, transactions, search, CSV upload, and mobile sidebar passed.
rca of the issue: Fresh database startup seeds rohan@siteexpense.com while requirements document rohan@siteexpense.local. Existing environment had the required local user, masking the fresh-install defect.
